subject: storytime
title: Pigeon and the Bus words
about: A bus driver steps away and asks the reader to keep an eye on his bus, and a pigeon spends the whole book begging, bargaining and throwing a fit to get behind the wheel. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him answering the pigeon on every page.

book.author: Mo Willems
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A very persistent pigeon tries every trick he knows to talk the reader into letting him drive.
